matching: Match descriptions to cars using car_id, or brand + model + year.

cars.description_en: An Italian coupé with hand-crafted styling inspired by classic racing cars. Its naturally aspirated V8 and distinctive silhouette combine elegance with a truly sporting sound.
A limited edition of the V12 Zagato, distinguished by sculpted bodywork designed by Zagato. It combines British luxury with a powerful V12 engine and a sporty character.
A rare, hand-built Aston Martin supercar. Its aluminium body, V12 engine and elegant proportions make it a blend of luxury and performance worthy of exotic supercars.
A compact sports coupé powered by a turbocharged five-cylinder engine. Quattro all-wheel drive and a short wheelbase deliver strong acceleration and confidence on winding roads.

A practical yet very fast mid-size estate or saloon powered by a naturally aspirated V8. Quattro all-wheel drive and a high-revving engine combine everyday usability with the character of a sports car.
A lighter, more performance-focused version of the R8. Its mid-mounted V10, all-wheel drive and precise handling make it a thoroughbred supercar built for fast driving.
A luxury grand tourer with all-wheel drive and a powerful W12 engine. The Continental GT combines long-distance comfort with strong performance and a substantial, elegant silhouette.

The E92-generation M3 features a high-revving, naturally aspirated V8 and rear-wheel drive. This sports coupé is built around precise handling, a stirring engine note and an engaging driving experience.
One of the fastest cars of its era, powered by a quad-turbocharged W16 engine. The Super Sport pushes the Veyron's performance to extreme levels while retaining all-wheel drive.
An American premium sports coupé with a supercharged V8. The CTS-V combines muscular styling, strong acceleration and comfort, showcasing Cadillac's more hard-edged side.
A classic American muscle car from the late 1960s, with a long bonnet and a powerful V8. The Camaro SS delivers raw character, strong torque and the iconic styling of the muscle-car era.
A classic C2 Corvette in its powerful 427 form, featuring a large V8. Relatively light by American standards, its striking proportions make it an icon of 1960s sports cars.
The open-top Corvette Grand Sport pairs a powerful V8 with roadster bodywork. It offers sports-car performance and open-air motoring while retaining unmistakable American style.
A modern Camaro with aggressive styling and a supercharged V8. The ZL1 delivers immense acceleration, an upgraded chassis and performance suited to both road and track.
The top-tier C6 Corvette, powered by a supercharged V8 and designed for exceptional performance. The ZR1 combines a relatively lightweight construction with huge power and effective aerodynamics.

A large rear-wheel-drive saloon with a powerful V8, combining a spacious cabin with American muscle-car character. The SRT-8 is quick in a straight line while retaining the practicality of a four-door car.
An SRT-8 392 muscle car powered by a large HEMI V8. Its long bonnet, wide body and strong torque emphasise classic American character in a modern package.
The California is an elegant Ferrari with a front-mounted V8 and a retractable hardtop. It combines sporting performance with everyday comfort and the option of open-top driving.
A legendary supercar from the late 1980s, powered by a twin-turbocharged V8 and built with minimal regard for comfort. The F40 is light, raw and focused above all on the driving experience.
The F50 was created as a road car inspired by Formula 1 technology. Its naturally aspirated V12, mid-engine layout and removable roof give it an unusually direct, race-bred character.
The 458 Spider combines a high-revving V8 with a retractable roof and modern aerodynamics. This striking Italian sports car focuses on speed, precision and an exhilarating engine note.
The 430 Scuderia is a lighter, more track-focused version of the F430. A quick gearbox, naturally aspirated V8 and reduced weight give it a direct, race-inspired character.

The Enzo Ferrari is a limited-production supercar named after the company's founder. Its carbon-fibre construction, naturally aspirated V12 and Formula 1-inspired engineering make it one of the most significant Ferraris of the early 2000s.
The Raptor is a pickup engineered for fast off-road driving. Its wide track, increased ground clearance and powerful V8 help it tackle rough terrain at speed.
The 2005 Ford GT pays tribute to the Le Mans-winning GT40. A mid-mounted supercharged V8, low silhouette and retro-modern bodywork create a distinctive blend of heritage and performance.
The Shelby GT500 is a high-performance Mustang with a supercharged V8. It combines classic muscle-car styling with modern traction and a huge reserve of power, especially under acceleration.
The Venom GT is an extreme, low-volume supercar designed around minimal weight and maximum speed. Its supercharged V8 and lightweight construction deliver hypercar-level performance.

The Integra Type R is a lightweight Honda sports car prized for its precise chassis and high-revving engine. Rather than relying on huge power, it offers low weight, responsiveness and excellent driver feedback.

The Genesis Coupé 3.8 Track is a rear-wheel-drive coupé with a naturally aspirated V6. The Track version focuses on sportier handling, while its powertrain and proportions give it the character of a classic sports coupé.
The IPL G Coupé is a sportier version of Infiniti's luxury coupé. A naturally aspirated V6, rear-wheel drive and tuned suspension combine comfort with a more dynamic character.

The XKR-S is the most performance-focused version of this generation of Jaguar's luxury coupé. A supercharged V8, muscular bodywork and tuned chassis combine British elegance with serious performance.

The Grand Cherokee SRT8 is a performance SUV with a large naturally aspirated V8. It combines a spacious SUV body and everyday comfort with strong acceleration and a noticeably sportier suspension setup.

The CCXR Edition is a rare Swedish hypercar with a supercharged V8 adapted to run on E85 fuel. Its lightweight construction and output of over 1,000 horsepower place it among the most extreme cars of its era.
The Countach is one of the icons of Italian supercars from the 1980s. Its angular bodywork, distinctive doors and high-revving V12 made it a symbol of bold, futuristic design.
The Diablo SV is a more performance-focused version of the classic V12 Lamborghini. Rear-wheel drive and aggressive styling give it the raw character typical of 1990s supercars.
The Reventón Roadster stands out with angular bodywork inspired by fighter aircraft. Its naturally aspirated V12 and open cockpit combine spectacular looks with brutal performance.
The Gallardo Superleggera is a lighter, more track-focused version of the Gallardo. All-wheel drive, a high-revving V10 and reduced weight deliver quick responses and strong acceleration.
The Murciélago LP 670-4 SV is an extreme, lightweight version of Lamborghini's flagship V12 model. All-wheel drive, extra power and aggressive aerodynamics underline its track-focused ambitions.
The Aventador LP700-4 introduced a modern carbon-fibre structure and a new naturally aspirated V12. All-wheel drive and futuristic bodywork make it a striking Lamborghini flagship.
The Range Rover Supercharged combines a luxurious interior and off-road capability with a supercharged V8. It is a large, comfortable SUV that can accelerate with surprising urgency.

The IS F is a Lexus sports saloon with a naturally aspirated V8 and rear-wheel drive. It combines Japanese build quality and comfort with the performance and soundtrack that set it apart from ordinary saloons.

The LFA is a limited-production Lexus supercar with a high-revving V10 and lightweight carbon-fibre construction. It is renowned for its extraordinary engine sound, precise handling and meticulous engineering.
The Exige Cup 240 is a small, very lightweight sports car with a racing focus. A mid-mounted engine, direct steering and minimal weight put handling ahead of comfort.

The GranTurismo S is an elegant Italian grand tourer powered by a naturally aspirated V8. It combines engine sound and sporting performance with long-distance comfort and Maserati's distinctive styling.

The first-generation MX-5 is a lightweight rear-wheel-drive roadster built for pure driving enjoyment. Its low weight, simple construction and agile chassis mean it does not need huge power to be fun.
The MP4-12C was McLaren's modern return to road-going supercars. Its lightweight construction, mid-mounted twin-turbo V8 and advanced chassis deliver impressive performance.
The ML 63 AMG is a luxury SUV powered by an AMG naturally aspirated V8. It combines a commanding driving position and practicality with rapid acceleration and the distinctive sound of a large engine.
The S 65 AMG is a luxury saloon with a hand-built, twin-turbocharged V12. Its character centres on enormous torque, a quiet cabin and effortless acceleration without sacrificing comfort.

The SL 65 AMG Black Series is a radical, limited-production version of the SL with a mighty twin-turbo V12. Wider bodywork, aggressive aerodynamics and performance-focused tuning set it apart from the luxury roadster.

The C 63 AMG Black Series is a track-oriented version of AMG's compact coupé, powered by a naturally aspirated V8. Its widened body, powerful brakes and sharper chassis give it a no-compromise character.
The Cooper S combines MINI's compact dimensions with a supercharged engine and nimble handling. Its short wheelbase and quick responses make it well suited to spirited driving on winding roads.
The GT-R Black Edition is a technologically advanced coupé with a twin-turbocharged V6 and all-wheel drive. Its effective traction and fast powertrain help it put substantial power down on the road.

The Zonda R is a track-only hypercar that was not designed for ordinary public-road use. Lightweight construction, a naturally aspirated V12 and extensive aerodynamics put lap times above everything else.
The 1977 Firebird Trans Am is a classic American muscle car with a distinctive front end and long bonnet. Its large V8 and bold styling made it a recognisable symbol of its era.

The RGT-8 is an unusual RUF model based on Porsche 911 architecture but fitted with a naturally aspirated V8 developed by RUF. It combines the familiar 911 silhouette with an unconventional powertrain and strong, linear power delivery.
The S7 is a hand-built American supercar with a mid-mounted V8. Its low weight, aerodynamic bodywork and, in later versions, forced induction give it performance worthy of an exotic supercar.
The FR-S is a lightweight rear-wheel-drive coupé developed around balance and handling. Its naturally aspirated boxer engine and low driving position encourage smooth, precise driving.

The A80-generation Supra RZ became an icon thanks to its turbocharged 2JZ-GTE inline-six and huge tuning potential. Its long bonnet, rear-wheel drive and strong engineering foundation make it a legend among Japanese sports cars.

The Sagaris is a lightweight, uncompromising British coupé with a naturally aspirated straight-six engine. Its distinctive body details and direct handling emphasise a raw, analogue driving experience.

The SRT Viper GTS is an American sports coupé with a huge naturally aspirated V10. Rear-wheel drive, a wide stance and abundant torque demand respect but deliver an intense, mechanical driving experience.

The ACR-X is a track-focused Viper variant built for racing, with an emphasis on aerodynamics, grip and reduced weight. Its powerful V10 and uncompromising setup make it a car designed primarily for circuit use.
